name: IndiPRO 24" Power Adapter Cable with 2.5mm to 2.5mm Male Plug - INDIWC2525
description: Provides a power cable from a 2.5mm power connector to a 2.5mm accessory power connector. The cable features male connectors on both ends. - Made In USA. The IndiPRO Tools 24" Power Cable, 2.5mm Male Plug to 2.5mm Male Plug provides a power cable from a 2.5mm power connector to a 2.5mm accessory power connector. The cable features male connectors on both ends. The cable is 24" long and made from 18 gauge stranded copper wire. It is created by splicing two pigtails together, the splice joint is soldered for strength and heat shrink wrapped for electrical insulation. The splice is then coated in silicone and sealed within a ferrite bead. The cable is tested to make sure it works before being shipped.
